تعلولوا (form XII)
# تَعْلَوْلُوا (taʕlawlū) /taʕ.law.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِعْلَوْلَى (iʕlawlā)
# تُعْلَوْلَوْا (tuʕlawlaw) /tuʕ.law.law/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِعْلَوْلَى (iʕlawlā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
